# Forest index

> The foundation's index of Forest. It ranks what is public: it reads the hosts it lists, keeps the profiles whose verification (a proof that the person behind the profile holds a stamp from a verifier this index counts as checking one real person) checks for a verifier key it lists, ranks each within its market, and serves what it finds as pages for people and as JSON for machines. Each profile shows its ratings (a weighted average from 1 to 10, as it is, with how many raters), its trust (0 to 100: how much its own words weigh, from the vouches, ratings and reports it gets) and its uniqueness (0 to 100: how sure the index is that it is one real person), signed. Each profile is one person's profile in one market and role; nothing here links one profile to another.

Every page has a JSON twin at the same address with `.json` on its path. Any AI that can read the web can read and browse these pages by links, from the home page to each market, each listing and its profile, with nothing to install and no login: no key and no sign-up. A fold on each profile's page, What these mean, says what its rating, trust and uniqueness mean.

## For AI agents

- [Read skill](https://index.forest.foundation/skill.md): every field and filter in plain words: how to search, read a market and a profile, and what ratings, trust and uniqueness mean
- [Markets](https://index.forest.foundation/index.json): every market, this index's address, and the lists it reads by
- [About](https://index.forest.foundation/about.json): this index's address and the lists it reads by; [its page](https://index.forest.foundation/about) says what this index is, what it reads and its address
- A market, at `https://index.forest.foundation/markets/<name>`, its twin with `.json`: its file, its status and its preview among the rest, and the listings this index lists, by role
- A listing, at `https://index.forest.foundation/profiles/<address>/listing/<id>`, its twin with `.json`: its photos, its fields in its market's order, who posted it and what that profile shows, and how to reach them
- [Search](https://index.forest.foundation/search.json?q=maths&market=tutoring): listings matching words and filters, a market's own fields among them, by their ratings with the market's average added, so few scores sit near it; near a point, the listings whose place reaches it, nearest first, each with its distance in km
- [Sitemap](https://index.forest.foundation/sitemap.xml): the home page, each market, each counted profile, and each listing this index lists
- [Reputation tree](https://index.forest.foundation/v1/reputation): this index's signed root, and [every leaf](https://index.forest.foundation/v1/reputation/leaves), each a profile's trust, for carrying a trust from one's own profiles without naming them

## How it works

- [What it reads, how it scores, and every number it uses](https://github.com/foundationforest/services/blob/main/index/README.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/foundationforest/services): open; anyone can run another index
